bio: Slug & Lettuce offers an Afternoon Tea that is perfect for celebrating special occassions with friends and family. Choose a Classic Tea for just £16 per person, or the Tipsy Tea, which includes two glasses of Prosecco, or cocktails, for just £22 per person.  The Slug & Lettuce Afternoon Tea menu features a choice of sandwiches, including Tuna Mayo & Cucumber and Chicken Mayo. Sweet treats include scones with jam & clotted cream and bite-sized Chocolate brownie, Limoncello drizzle sponge and Cookie-crumb profiteroles.  Set within the heart of Aldgate, Slug & Lettuce is just a short walk from either Aldgate or Tower Hill station.
